name: NovelAI
summary: Storytelling and co-writing platform with a strong lorebook system, image generation, and uncensored text models (Xialong, Krake, Llama 3 Erato). More writing desk than companion — watchlist.
ranking_rationale: Watchlist, not the top 10: it is a writing/co-writing tool rather than a companion product, and there is no companion-facing free tier. Priced first-party on the official docs, so it still gets a full record.

pricing.free_tier: Trial: 30 image generations, 50 text generations, 100 TTS (email verification required)

pricing.notes: Subscriptions renew every 30 days per official docs. Image generation is free on Opus under size/steps limits; otherwise Anlas.
